services.name: PLC Services
services.short: PLC programming, retrofits and troubleshooting for machines and process lines.
services.cardText: Control logic for machines and process lines — new programs, migrations from obsolete controllers and I/O expansion.
body: DICS engineers design, program and commission PLC-based control architectures for individual machines and complete process lines.
Work covers new application programming, migration of obsolete controllers, I/O expansion, communication networking and fault diagnosis on running systems.
challenges: Unplanned downtime caused by logic faults
Integrating new equipment into existing lines

services.name: HMI Services
services.short: Operator panel design, screen development and HMI replacement.
services.cardText: Operator screens, alarms and supervisory visibility so teams can see and act on process conditions.
body: DICS develops operator interfaces that give your team clear visibility of machine and process conditions.
Work covers screen design and development, alarm handling, recipe and data screens, and replacement of discontinued HMI panels.
challenges: Need for supervisory visibility across machines

services.name: VFD & AC Drive Services
services.short: Selection, parameterisation, commissioning and repair of variable frequency drives.
services.cardText: Motor speed control, soft starting and drive commissioning to reduce mechanical stress and support energy-efficient operation.
body: DICS supports variable frequency drive applications from selection through commissioning and service.
Work covers drive selection, parameter setting, motor speed control, soft starting, commissioning and repair.
challenges: High energy use on variable-load motors

services.name: Servo AC/DC Drive Services
services.short: Servo system tuning, commissioning and service for precise motion.
services.cardText: Servo, stepper and multi-axis systems for positioning, indexing and synchronised motion.
body: DICS supports servo and motion applications that need precise positioning and repeatable motion.
Work covers servo system tuning, commissioning, multi-axis set-up and service.
challenges: Tuning servo loops for new mechanics

services.name: Factory Automation & System Integration

services.cardText: Electrical design, panel fabrication, software and commissioning delivered as one project.
body: DICS delivers end-to-end project execution: electrical design, panel fabrication, software development and field commissioning.
Specification, programming and commissioning stay in one place, backed by lifecycle support.
challenges: Coordinating several vendors on one project
Need for a single point of responsibility
